primaryTextRead.text: Then the LORD’s Spirit came on Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, the Levite, of the sons of Asaph, in the middle of the assembly;

wikipediaRead.title: Benaiah
wikipediaRead.locator: L135–141 lists multiple distinct Benaiahs; L139 identifies the Levite descendant of Asaph at 2 Chronicles 20:14.

wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: The article’s “Other Benaiahs” section explicitly matches the profile’s 2 Chronicles 20:14 genealogy, separate from Benaiah son of Jehoiada.
